canonical_definition: Text Generation is the behavior involving production of textual outputs (including code, explanations, or simulation components) from prompts or inputs, often requiring decomposition into sub-tasks, articulation of intermediate reasoning steps, or use of chain-of-thought prompting; it encompasses code generation tasks evaluated via benchmarks like MBPP or HumanEval (using metrics such as pass@1) and long-context generation where positional encoding adaptivity impacts performance.
